$schema_doc: Placement constraints for the AMS1117-3.3 LDO (U5) and its bulk caps. Per the AMS1117 datasheet typical application circuit, an input bulk cap belongs at U5.3 (Vin, +5V) and an output bulk cap belongs at U5.2 (Vout, +3V3). The +3V3 rail also gets distributed per-pin decoupling at every IC consumer (covered by other targets files), but U5 itself needs local bulk to handle transient load steps from the rest of the +3V3 consumers. Run `python3 hardware/pcb/v2/tools/check_ldo_placement.py`.

constraints.rationale: Input bulk cap on +5V rail at U5 Vin pin. AMS1117 datasheet recommends a 10uF tantalum or aluminum at the input; ceramic 10uF is acceptable in modern practice. NOTE: U5 is SOT-223 with a generous courtyard, so the 0603 cap can't sit directly adjacent to the pad without a courtyard violation; 7mm is the practical minimum that keeps the cap on the same side of U5 as the pad.

Output bulk cap on +3V3 rail at U5 Vout pin. Same SOT-223 courtyard limit as C11; 12mm is the achievable minimum for the existing layout where C9 sits on the opposite side of U5 from the Vout pad. Future improvement: re-place C9 on the same side as Vout if the surrounding cluster can be rearranged to make room without colliding with the codec cluster.
